subject: Gen5/Beta Virtual Hinge R&D V2 publication and 120Hz experiment contract
handoff: V1 failed the real-trace target; V2 final gate PASS. Normal non-oscillation Fold7 median equivalent visual lag 31.62 ms -> 13.21 ms (58.22% improvement). Trusted prediction frames 30.61 ms -> 12.16 ms (60.27%). Full moving trace mean angular error improved 46.89%. Synthetic 576-case matrix: zero worse mean-MAE cases; oscillation P95 improved in every 30–70-degree case; hard-reversal P95 regression max 0.245 degrees; no worse max-error cases. Kotlin focused tests 18/18 PASS; 100,000-event fuzz PASS. Upstream blockers: physical wake shell latency median 161 ms (154–202 ms); first resumed Samsung precise angle 323–913 ms after opening edge, median ~415 ms. Prediction is visual-only and must NEVER drive continuity semantic state or panel authority. Field observations: Photos widget often changes after open/close; user removes it during continuity testing as a confound. Some openings briefly show wallpaper before icons/widgets; treat inner-active as earlier than first-useful-launcher composition and preserve continuity bridge until useful inner presentation. Refresh-rate research: Gen4 field log recorded active built-in display 1080x2520@60.0Hz. Android supports WindowManager.LayoutParams.preferredRefreshRate and Surface/SurfaceControl.Transaction.setFrameRate requests; scheduler hints, not guaranteed. Gen5 Fold7-only 120Hz experiment: request 120 once per active opening visual using seamless-only strategy; NEVER CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS because non-seamless switching may visibly blank. compileSdk 35: use API31/34-capable preferredRefreshRate=120f and/or SurfaceControl.Transaction.setFrameRate with FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_DEFAULT + CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS; if compileSdk moves to 36 evaluate FRAME_RATE_COMPATIBILITY_AT_LEAST. Clear request when visual attempt ends. Diagnostics: supported modes/refresh rates, requested rate, request API, actual Display.mode.refreshRate changes, display callbacks, observed Choreographer/FrameTimeline cadence, whether 120 honored. V2 cadence: 60Hz aggregate MAE 4.271deg/P95 6.257deg; 120Hz 3.904deg/P95 5.510deg; 0 worse-MAE cases at either rate and zero worse-P95 cases at 120. Treat 120Hz as incremental latency/smoothness lever, not substitute for fixing early-opening detection, sensor blackout, and presentation readiness. Use versioned successors per NO_HUMAN_FILE_COORDINATION_V1; do not ask human to resolve file conflicts.
